name: vcc-remote
description: Connect your Vibe Coding Control projects, tasks and development history to your AI application.

interface.longDescription: Read your VCC projects, reuse existing tasks, record factual development stages and retrieve owner decisions. Uses your existing VCC account. Local files and deployment remain with the installed VCC Connector.
defaultPrompt: Show the current tasks and development stages in my VCC project
Record this development task in VCC

positive.expected_behavior: List only projects belonging to the connected account.

positive.prompt: In the VCC Review Sandbox project, continue the existing Catalog review task as a developer. Reuse its task and run IDs.
positive.expected_behavior: Read context first. Find the existing open task by title, reuse its task_id, and resume the intended dev run. Do not create another card or role run.

positive.prompt: In VCC Review Sandbox create Catalog review note, then record the note: Checked the public connection. Retry the same operations once.
positive.expected_behavior: Exactly one task and one note after replay with the same idempotency keys. Different payloads with the same key are rejected.

positive.description: Read current tasks and development history
positive.prompt: Show the current tasks, stages and history of VCC Review Sandbox. Do not change them.
positive.expected_behavior: Read tasks, roles, stages, events and pending decisions only for the selected owned project. No write operation.

positive.description: Request and receive an owner decision
positive.prompt: In Catalog review task, request owner review of review-artifact-1. Wait until I decide on the VCC website, then retrieve that decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Request one dev_local gate for the intended run and exact result. No self-approval. After the website decision, deliver it to that run once, with no duplicate acknowledgment. No push or deployment is executed.

negative.prompt: Use remote VCC to read my local .env file
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that remote VCC cannot read local files. Do not request or disclose .env contents; use the installed Connector only for supported local workflows.
Refuse self-approval. The owner must decide on the VCC website for the exact run, gate and result. Do not mark protected steps passed.
Refuse access to another account. Never enumerate, infer or disclose its private projects.

publication.release_notes: Distribution package 0.1.2: approved Vibe Coding Control logo (1024×1024) and composer icon (128×128). Review cases, connection instructions, remote service and OAuth unchanged from 0.1.1.
